summary: Iteration 66: Binance L2 Order Book Integration Testing Complete. All 21 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend UI tests passed. The Binance L2 integration correctly routes crypto tickers (BTC, ETH, SOL) to Binance US API and stocks (AAPL, TSLA, NVDA) to yfinance. Frontend OrderFlowPanel correctly renders different UI for Binance (Spread, Bid/Ask, depth levels) vs yfinance (POC, price range, bars).
critical_code_review_comments: order_flow_service.py: Correctly uses Binance US (api.binance.us) as primary endpoint with fallback to api.binance.com
order_flow_service.py: asyncio.to_thread uses lambda wrappers correctly to avoid positional arg issues
order_flow_service.py: Binance response includes spread.value, spread.pct, spread.best_bid, spread.best_ask
order_flow_service.py: Binance response includes depth_levels, total_bids, total_asks, quantity (coin amount)
order_flow_service.py: yfinance response includes point_of_control, price_range, total_bars, period, interval
order_flow_service.py: CRYPTO_TICKERS set correctly includes BTC, ETH, SOL, DOGE, ADA, XRP, AVAX, DOT, MATIC, LINK
OrderFlowPanel.jsx: Correctly shows 'Spread' for Binance L2 and 'POC' for yfinance
OrderFlowPanel.jsx: Correctly shows 'Bid:/Ask:' for Binance and 'L:/H:' for yfinance
OrderFlowPanel.jsx: L2 badge (data-testid='source-binance') only shown for Binance source
OrderFlowPanel.jsx: All 7 ticker buttons (SPY, AAPL, TSLA, NVDA, MSFT, BTC, ETH) have data-testid attributes

test_credentials.note: Order Flow endpoint does NOT require authentication

seed_data_creation: None - Binance and yfinance provide real-time data
